descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S04 Existing specs: Save & Extract closes and adds tasks and records medication changes, and a later Generate does not send the notes to the medication extractor again

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing, once and with no duplicates, leaves unmatched tasks open, and records the dictated medication events. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 2; TFA-92592 rule 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Tim's chromium specs with the model mocked at the Convex socket

When Run the four specs by title

Then Hospital Save & Extract persists an extracted task and three medication changes; Nursing Home Save & Extract closes the matched task, keeps the unmatched one open and adds new ones; a later Generate makes no second medication-extraction call for the same notes

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright verdicts. This covers the wiring only (mocked model). AI quality of the matching is S05 and TC-22. U3 is not claimed here: 'Generate does not send Save & Extract's notes to the extractor again' asserts only the medication-extraction calls (toHaveLength(1)); …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-14/S04

Existing specs: Save & Extract closes and adds tasks and records medication changes, and a later Generate does not send the notes to the medication extractor again

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status blocked in newspec-c/results.json → blocked (blocked).

Detail:

Blocked (local live-model guard, coordinator 2026-10-15): lane A on 43c38a4f (spec-matrix S04,S25) ran all four titles and they passed — encounter-workflow 'Save & Extract persists a model-extracted action item', snf-save-extract 'Save & Extract saves the notes, closes and adds tasks, and keeps a codeword task verbatim', medication-detection 'Save & Extract automatically detects and persists medication changes', medication-tracker 'Generate does not send Save & Extract's notes to the extractor again' — but the last title stores a (mocked) note, and on 43c38a4f the server then starts the billing job by itself: the tripwire listed 1 live billing.suggestBilling and 1 live parsing.classifyAdmissionReason call at 18:00:55 JST (the test does not mock the classifier). Per the coordinator's rule a local run that reached the live model is not used as a verdict and is not re-run. The same requirements are covered without any model call by TC-14/S06 (local, passed: no task extraction after Generate, nothing added twice, one medication event per change) and on dev by S01 / S02 / S05.

Evidence: 2 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's chromium specs): they make fresh @roundai.test accounts and mock the model at the Convex socket through the local stack's e2e helpers and admin key; dev has no admin key, no action mock and one shared account, so they run on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local matrix (lane A)] passed (matrix/TC-14.results.json)
